svg.title: NTP: the 48-byte header of a client request
svg.desc: The NTP header of frame 3 of tcpdump_ntp.pcap, 32 bits per row: the byte 0x23 (leap indicator 0, version 4, mode 3, client), stratum 0, poll 0, precision 32, a zero root delay, root dispersion and reference id, a zero reference timestamp, then the origin, receive and transmit timestamps, which chrony fills with random values; the NtpPacket struct on the right holds the same fields, and the 24 bytes after the header, a key id and a SHA-1 digest, are not decoded.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
